# TimedText:Deutschlandlied (Weimar Republic).mp3.en.srt

1
00:00:01,025 --> 00:00:05,330
Germany, Germany above all,
2
00:00:05,550 --> 00:00:10,500
Above all in the world,
3
00:00:10,500 --> 00:00:14,700
When it always stands united
4
00:00:15,100 --> 00:00:19,700
Brotherly in protection and defence.
5
00:00:20,100 --> 00:00:24,300
From the Meuse to the Neman,
6
00:00:24,600 --> 00:00:29,100
From the Adige to the Little Belt,
7
00:00:29,500 --> 00:00:34,400
Germany, Germany above all,
8
00:00:34,800 --> 00:00:39,300
Above all in the world!
9
00:00:40,300 --> 00:00:45,300
Germany, Germany above all,
10
00:00:45,600 --> 00:00:51,500
Above all in the world!
11
00:00:52,300 --> 00:00:57,400
German women, German loyalty,
12
00:00:57,800 --> 00:01:01,300
German wine and German song
13
00:01:02,200 --> 00:01:06,600
Shall retain in the world
14
00:01:07,300 --> 00:01:11,700
Their old, beautiful sound,
15
00:01:12,100 --> 00:01:16,400
Inspiring us to noble deeds
16
00:01:17,200 --> 00:01:21,700
Throughout our entire lives –
17
00:01:22,100 --> 00:01:26,700
German women, German loyalty,
18
00:01:27,100 --> 00:01:32,300
German wine and German song!
19
00:01:33,100 --> 00:01:37,400
German women, German loyalty,
20
00:01:37,800 --> 00:01:43,600
German wine and German song!
21
00:01:44,900 --> 00:01:49,700
Unity and justice and freedom
22
00:01:49,550 --> 00:01:54,400
For the German fatherland!
23
00:01:55,100 --> 00:01:59,300
Let us strive for this together,
24
00:02:00,200 --> 00:02:04,100
Brotherly with heart and hand!
25
00:02:05,150 --> 00:02:09,100
Unity and justice and freedom
26
00:02:10,200 --> 00:02:14,100
Are the foundation of happiness –
27
00:02:14,500 --> 00:02:20,700
Bloom in the radiance of this happiness,
28
00:02:21,300 --> 00:02:26,300
Bloom, German fatherland!
29
00:02:26,700 --> 00:02:32,100
Bloom in the radiance of this happiness,
30
00:02:32,200 --> 00:02:39,600
Bloom, German fatherland!
